pages.text: A full working bag requests cargo pickup. Missing tools request one compatible spare; tools retain wear, enchantments, names, and tags. Farm workers need hoes, lumberjacks axes, miners pickaxes/shovels, and combat workers swords.

Miner fluid removal requests one empty bucket. Wall reinforcement requests up to 64 cobblestone. Healers request up to 64 slimeballs. Supply is limited by stock and usable space; full bags need unloading first.

Carriers recheck the request before delivery, so two carriers do not overfill it. Follow and Wait withdraw requests. $(l:companions/herald)Heralds$() report continuous blocked work; a retry alone does not erase that duration.
